Could not reach GitHub. Check your connection and try again.
GitHub is limiting requests from this network right now. Try again in an hour.
The downloaded file is not a valid app package.
The installed app is signed with a different key, so it cannot be updated in place. Uninstall it first and then install it again. This removes the app\'s data.

Apps whose developers have added the topic arkstore to their GitHub repository appear in the store for everyone. Here you can also add a GitHub account or a single repository yourself, for example your own, by name or link. An app appears when its latest release has an APK attached.
Enter a GitHub account name, owner/repo or a github.com link.
This source has already been added.
Nothing was found on GitHub with that name.
Only public repositories with an open-source license are listed. Developers choose the category with a second topic such as arkstore-tools.
This repository has no open-source license that GitHub recognises, so it cannot be listed.
Offer prereleases as updates when a developer has published one. They are newer but less tested.
Draws the screen and everything on it as brushed metal lit from above, computed by the graphics processor. Needs Android 13.
Turning this off offers stable versions again. A beta that is already installed stays until the next stable version replaces it; to go back sooner, open the app\'s details.
A newer beta is installed. The next stable version will replace it.
A newer beta of this app is installed. The next stable version replaces it by itself. To go back now, uninstall the app and install it again from the store. Uninstalling removes the app\'s data.
A newer beta of ARK-Store is installed. The next stable version replaces it by itself. To go back now, uninstall ARK-Store and install the stable version from its GitHub page.
The app and its data are removed. After that, install the stable version from the list.
Tells you when installed apps have a newer version
On. ARK-Store checks for updates in the background and notifies you about them.
Off. Android is not letting ARK-Store show notifications, so updates are only shown when you open the app.
Shows the progress of app downloads
Open-source apps found by searching GitHub. Their developers have not published them to ARK-Store, and nobody has checked them. Only actively developed apps with a recent release are included.
This app was found by searching GitHub. Its developer has not published it to ARK-Store.
Apps their developers have added to ARK-Store themselves, on GitHub, Codeberg or GitLab. Always shown.
Open-source apps found by searching GitLab, another code hosting service. Few projects there attach their apps to releases, so this list is short. Nobody has checked these apps.
This app was found by searching GitLab. Its developer has not published it to ARK-Store.
Open-source apps found by searching Codeberg, a code hosting service like GitHub. Their developers have not published them to ARK-Store, and nobody has checked them.
This app was found by searching Codeberg. Its developer has not published it to ARK-Store.
A separately maintained catalogue of open-source apps. It passes on the developers\' own files after scanning them.
The best-known catalogue of open-source apps. F-Droid builds the apps from their source itself and signs most of them with its own key, so an app installed from F-Droid is also updated from F-Droid.

An app offered by several of these is listed once: from its developer when possible, then from IzzyOnDroid, then from F-Droid. An installed app stays with the place whose files are signed the way it is.
This app is offered through the %1$s catalogue. Its developer has not published it to ARK-Store.
A newer version than the one offered here is installed.
The installed app is signed with the same key as the version offered here, so ARK-Store can update it.
Whether the installed app is signed with the same key as the version offered here is not known yet. It is checked once the file has been downloaded.
Installed from another source. ARK-Store cannot update it.

The installed app is signed with a different key than the version offered here, usually because it was installed from another store. Android does not let ARK-Store update it. To switch to this version, uninstall the app first and then install it from here. Uninstalling removes the app\'s data.
Tells you when a downloaded app is waiting for you to confirm its installation
